namespace App\Providers;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\App;
class Bindings {
 function register(\Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container $container) {
   $this->app->bind(\App\Port::class, \App\Service::class);
   App::singleton('service', fn (): \App\Port => new \App\Service);
   app()->bind('conditional', function ($app) { if ($app) return new \App\First; return new \App\Second; });
   $container->bind('typed', \App\Service::class);
   $this->app->when([\App\Consumer::class])->needs(\App\Port::class)->give(\App\Service::class);
   app()->when(\App\Consumer::class)->needs('$value')->give('secret');
 }
 function invalidated(\Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container $container) { $container = unknown(); $container->bind('omitted', \App\Service::class); }
}
App::bind(fn(): \App\Port => new \App\Service);
